# noqeri/fetch 0.1.0

Non-blocking fetch handle API for browser .nqo modules.

Install the exact 0.1.0 package through the Noqeri registry, or import its canonical source in your application:

```noqeri
import package "noqeri/fetch"
```

Status: experimental. Native compiler and provider runtime qualification remain required. Previous release sources are preserved under their original version directories.
